title: Concrete Pump for Tunnel and Secondary Lining
seoTitle: Concrete Pump for Tunnel Lining | Pinjin Trailers
description: Tunnel lining on a Pinjin trailer is pipeline placement, not a shotcrete robot. Diesel 50 lists 30 m³/h and 150 m / 450 m; Electric 80 lists 60 m³/h and 900 m / 300 m when a grid exists. Exhaust and ventilation are the contractor’s duty — no invented tunnel certificate.

answerBlock.what: A tunnel or secondary-lining job at Pinjin is matched as a trailer pipeline pour: mix, aggregate, output and H/V inside a printed row. Diesel 50 lists 99 kW, 30 m³/h, 30 MPa, 150 m / 450 m. LZ-80 lists Yuchai 256 kW, high/low pressure output ≤ 65 / ≤ 95 m³/h, conveying 120 m, hopper 0.6 m³ (delivery height: consult factory). Electric 80 lists 110 kW, 60 m³/h, 900 m / 300 m when the heading has grid. We do not list a shotcrete robot, a placing boom or a ventilation certificate. Initial support spray belongs on the sprayer hub only if particle stays inside ≤8 mm / ≤6 mm.
answerBlock.who: Contractors placing lining concrete through pipe in a tunnel or underground heading who can state power, pipe length and max stone.
factors: Pipeline lining versus wet-mix spray (different Pinjin hubs)
Grid → electric table; no grid → diesel table
Diesel exhaust in a heading is not a published Pinjin ventilation rate
Output/distance must sit in the printed pair — Diesel 50 is not Electric 80

faqs.question: Do you sell a tunnel shotcrete robot for primary lining?
faqs.answer: No. Wet hose sprayers are on /products/spraying-machines with particle ≤8 mm or ≤6 mm. Trailer pumps place pipeline concrete. Neither family is named as a robotic shotcrete arm.

faqs.question: Diesel or electric for an underground heading?
faqs.answer: If the heading can feed 110 kW, Electric 80 is the long-distance electric row (60 m³/h, 900 m / 300 m). If there is no grid, Diesel 50 (30 m³/h, 150 m / 450 m) or LZ-80 is the diesel discussion. Exhaust and ventilation stay with the contractor. We do not publish a tunnel emission certificate.

faqs.question: Is secondary lining the same as floor screed or secondary structure columns?
faqs.answer: No. Secondary lining here means a tunnel or underground concrete lining pour through pipe. House secondary structure (columns/beams) is a different article. Floor screed is another. Send the heading length, mix and power so we open the correct table.
